query:
UPDATE agent_wake
           SET failures = failures + 1,
               last_error = $2,
               enabled = enabled AND failures + 1 < $3,
               disabled_at = CASE WHEN enabled AND failures + 1 >= $3 THEN now()
                                  ELSE disabled_at END
         WHERE agent_id = $1
        RETURNING disabled_at IS NOT NULL AND disabled_at >= now() AS "switched_off!"
